name: Kami
description: Spirits of the forest who retaliated against deforestation.

description_citations.text: "Towashi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Takeno warns his men that the kami are coming, calming Isamaru.
timeline.quote: Alert the men. The kami are coming.

citation.text: Isamaru, Hound of Konda (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Spirits of weapons turn against great warriors in the first days of the war.
timeline.quote: Many great warriors died in the first days of the war

citation.text: Kabuto Moth (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kami at Reito crush the militia and minor kami consume what remained.
timeline.quote: When the rampaging kami at Reito had crushed the opposing militia, swarms of minor kami swept over the battlefield to consume all that remained.

citation.text: Befoul (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Humans escape three legions of kami at Ganzan Pass.
timeline.quote: The untrained and frightened group escaped three legions of kami

citation.text: Rend Spirit (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Only Eiganjo Castle stands after the kami strike.
timeline.quote: Only Eiganjo Castle remained standing, glistening untouched in the sun.

citation.text: Stone Rain (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Honden of Cleansing Fire is abandoned and its zubera swarm Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: When the Honden of Cleansing Fire was abandoned, its attendants swarmed Kamigawa to erode mortal will.

citation.text: Silent-Chant Zubera (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Dosan continues his prayers even as kami hatred slowly kills him.
timeline.quote: Though the kami are slowly killing him, still he continues his prayers.

citation.text: Dosan the Falling Leaf (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hoto's last words as a kami attacks Jiro near home.
timeline.quote: The kami would never attack us this close to home

citation.text: Kami of the Hunt (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The spirits of Kamigawa suddenly and inexplicably begin to wage war on the plane's mortal inhabitants.
timeline.quote: the spirits that are the essence of everything on it suddenly and inexplicably begin to wage war with its mortal inhabitants

citation.text: "Champions of Kamigawa", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towashi's growth consumed the edges of Jukai and enclosed the grove of Boseiju, displacing forest kami.
timeline.quote: As Towashi's boundaries stretched outward, the city began encroaching upon the ancient Jukai Forest, gradually consuming its edges.

citation.text: "Jukai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The angered kami attacked, demolishing new structures and cursing those responsible.
timeline.quote: the kami unleashed their wrath by demolishing recently built structures and casting curses upon those responsible for the desecration.

citation.text: "Jukai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The emperor brokered an agreement: Towashi would stop growing into the forest, Boseiju could not be cut down, and Jukai closed to mortals without the kami's permission.
timeline.quote: He brokered an agreement that the city would halt further growth into the forest.

citation.text: "Jukai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians kill kami en masse.
timeline.quote: As they have no flesh to be compleated, they were killed en masse by the Phyrexians.

citation.text: "Kami", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The enraged kami attack the physical world to reclaim That Which Was Taken, and mortals lose a losing battle.
timeline.quote: Lord Konda's act greatly enraged the spirits, who turned against the physical world with a vengeance.

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towashi's expansion into Jukai Forest angers the kami, who retaliate.
timeline.quote: rose from the forest depths to retaliate

citation.text: "Towashi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The emperor brokers an agreement halting growth into the forest and forbidding cutting Boseiju.
timeline.quote: He brokered an agreement that the city would halt further growth into the forest.

citation.text: "Towashi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kami pass over Mita and make villagers relive their tragedies, sapping their will to fight.
timeline.quote: As the kami passed over the village of Mita, the inhabitants relived their three most grievous tragedies.

citation.text: Three Tragedies (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Takada faces the kami alone as last of the rearguard.
timeline.quote: Takada, last of the rearguard, faced the kami alone.

citation.text: Ashen Monstrosity (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kami passing through the veil weaken it.
timeline.quote: The more kami that passed through the veil that separated them from our world, the weaker that veil became

citation.text: Cut the Earthly Bond (Saviors of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Minor kami spill through a rip in the veil and vanish.
timeline.quote: Through the veil's rip spilled hundreds of minor kami

citation.text: Glitterfang (Saviors of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kami trapped for eons within the sacred gong destroy their prison.
timeline.quote: Trapped for eons within the sacred gong, the kami boomed and clanged to a deafening tempo as they destroyed their erstwhile prison.

citation.text: Sunder from Within (Saviors of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Even the benevolent kirin join the war against the mortal world.
timeline.quote: Even the most benevolent and life-giving of kami joined the war against the mortal world

citation.text: Bounteous Kirin (Saviors of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Toshi, despite avoiding the conflict, becomes the center of the war between the spirit and human realms.
timeline.quote: But despite his best efforts, he's not only involved in it, he's at the center of it.

citation.text: "Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi and Princess Michiko must find a way to stave off the impending victory of the kami.
timeline.quote: he must find a way to stave off the impending victory of the kami

citation.text: "Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: About 1200 years after the Kami War, the kami are threatened by the growth of Towashi.
timeline.quote: About 1200 years after the Kami War the kami are threatened by the growth of the modern city of Towashi.

citation.text: "Kami", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Boseiju bursts apart and oil pours from it, killing and dissolving the kami.
timeline.quote: Boseiju, the tree that once held this plane together, bursts apart.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 3: Mother, Son, and Story" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The destruction of Boseiju in the New Phyrexian Invasion kills many kami.
timeline.quote: With the New Phyrexian Invasion , the destruction of Boseiju caused the death of many kami.

citation.text: "Kami", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians invade Kamigawa; samurai are quickly compleated and the incompleatable kami are slaughtered.
timeline.quote: The Kami, incompleatable, were simply slaughtered

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The enraged kami attack the physical world and mortals fight back in a losing battle.
timeline.quote: The kami began to attack the physical world to reclaim

citation.text: "Kami War", section "Conflict". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The kami begin to take form in the material world while Konda's armies secure territory.
timeline.quote: Even as his armies and samurai secured more territory in Konda's name, the kami manifested in ever-greater numbers.

citation.text: "Kamigawa". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The kami set upon the town of Reito, killing nearly every living thing, and the Kami War begins.
timeline.quote: A few miles from Eiganjo Castle, the kami set upon the town of Reito.

citation.text: "Kamigawa". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: It is revealed that Konda began the war by kidnapping a kami, with moonfolk aid, to secure his own power and immortality.
timeline.quote: With aid from moonfolk allies, Konda kidnapped a kami to secure his own power and immortality.

citation.text: "Kamigawa". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tameshi apprentices under Katsumasa and makes origami drones to house kami, later developing technology letting kami merge into robot bodies.
timeline.quote: he later built on this design to develop a technology that made it possible for Kami to merge into robot bodies

citation.text: "Tameshi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: the Order of Jukai has built temples to make sure the kami feel welcomed

citation.text: "Jukai", section "The Order of Jukai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
